incidents.title: Incident center
incidents.description: Outages, measured availability and notification delivery in one place.
incidents.selectHost: Select a host to see availability, latency and alarm mutes.
incidents.availabilityHelp: Uptime uses known measurements only. Coverage shows how much time is known; gaps and paused checks remain unknown. Values are estimates between checks, up to one configured interval.
incidents.latencyHelp: One-minute averages of successful checks. Gaps are not interpolated.
incidents.noLatency: No successful latency samples in the last 24 hours.
incidents.muteHelp: Suppress notifications for this host without changing its maintenance page or health checks. Times use your local timezone.
incidents.targetHelp: Public HTTPS endpoints only. Stored URLs and tokens stay hidden. Empty URL preserves the saved endpoint; leave the token unchanged to retain it.
incidents.name: Name
incidents.deliveryHelp: Failed requests retry up to five times. Delivery is at least once; webhook receivers can deduplicate the Idempotency-Key.
incidents.noDeliveries: No deliveries yet. Enable alerts in a host's monitoring settings.
incidents.noTargets: Add a webhook, ntfy or Discord channel to receive incident notifications.
incidents.deleteTarget: Delete this notification channel and its delivery history?
incidents.error: The incident center could not be loaded.
